data.name: Amory
data.gender_notes: Amory is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Amoros, meaning 'love'. In Christian tradition, the name Amory is associated with the virtue of love, particularly the selfless and divine love of God. The name Amory carries the meaning “Love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amory usually hope their child will grow to embody love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Amory belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amory total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
